theme.title: Past Meets Present
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: The chart shows regular-season wins for four other East finalists. How many did the 2019–20 Heat win before their Bubble run to the Finals?
questions.context: Miami · Jimmy Butler's first season · 73 games before the Bubble
questions.note: 44–29, a fifth seed's record; Miami then knocked out top-seeded Milwaukee on the way to the Finals.

funFacts.text: This was Miami's first complete season without retired Dwyane Wade.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: It was the first time since 2016-17 that Dwyane Wade was not on the Miami Heat roster

funFacts.text: Jimmy Butler was in his first season with Miami.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: It was the first season for Jimmy Butler on the Heat

funFacts.text: Miami was among twenty-two teams invited to the NBA bubble.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Heat were one of 22 teams invited to the NBA Bubble

questions.prompt: The chart shows three famous winning streaks. How long was the 2013–14 Spurs' longest winning streak?
questions.note: It ran from late February to early April and included a perfect 16–0 March.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Emboldened by a 19-game winning streak from late February to early April, including an unbeaten month in March (16–0)

funFacts.text: San Antonio's title was revenge for a heartbreaking Finals loss to Miami the previous season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Spurs avenged their 2013 NBA Finals loss and became NBA champions

funFacts.text: The team's run included an undefeated March, a remarkable display of consistency across a packed schedule.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: including an unbeaten month in March (16–0)

funFacts.text: Dallas nearly ruined the championship march, taking the Spurs to the limit in the opening playoff round.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Mavericks in the regular season for 2 consecutive years. San Antonio won 4–3

questions.prompt: Kobe Bryant scored 81 in a January 2006 game. How many did he score in his final NBA game, at age 37?
questions.note: 60, and at 37 years, 234 days he became the oldest player ever to score 60 in a game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the oldest is Bryant (60 points; 37 years and 234 days)

funFacts.text: The Lakers later retired both of Kobe's jersey numbers, an unprecedented honor for one NBA player.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: making him the only NBA player to have multiple numbers retired by one franchise

funFacts.text: Kobe had entered the league straight from high school and won a slam dunk contest while still a teenager.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: won the 1997 Slam Dunk Contest, the youngest dunk champion at age 18

funFacts.text: His final seasons were repeatedly interrupted by injuries after the end of his championship years.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: His remaining playing career was hampered by injuries and reduced playing time

questions.prompt: Wilt Chamberlain grabbed 31 rebounds in one half against Bill Russell's Celtics in 1960. How many did he finish that game with?
questions.context: Philadelphia Warriors vs Boston Celtics · November 24, 1960
questions.note: An NBA record. He also scored 34, and Boston won anyway, 132–129.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On November 24, 1960, Chamberlain grabbed an NBA-record 55 rebounds, along with 34 points and 4 assists

funFacts.text: Wilt added 34 points and four assists in the same game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Chamberlain grabbed an NBA-record 55 rebounds, along with 34 points and 4 assists

funFacts.text: Boston still won the game, 132–129, in Philadelphia.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: in a 132–129 home loss against the Russell-led Boston Celtics

funFacts.text: He won eleven rebounding titles in his career.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He won seven scoring, eleven rebounding, nine durability, and nine field goal percentage titles.

questions.context: Brooklyn Nets vs Milwaukee Bucks · East semifinals · Game 5
